definitions.rationale: This is the empty-sequence base equation of the recursively defined mathematical summary oddIndexEvenSum.
This is the singleton-sequence base equation of the recursively defined mathematical summary oddIndexEvenSum.
This recurrence defines oddIndexEvenSum on a sequence with at least two elements by summarizing the odd-indexed element and recursing on the remaining pairs.
definitions.text:
rule oddIndexEvenSum(cons(_, cons(ITEM, REST)))
    => evenPart(ITEM) +Int oddIndexEvenSum(REST)

definitions.rationale: This macro expansion defines the named proof term solutionProgram as the exact translated constructor tree used by the end-to-end claim.
definitions.text:
rule solutionProgram =>
    Module(
      FuncDef("add", Params("lst"),
        Return(
          IfExp(
            Compare(Call(Name("len"), Name("lst")), CmpOp("<", Int(2))),
            Int(0),
            BinOp(
              "+",
              IfExp(
                Compare(
                  BinOp("%", Subscript(Name("lst"), Int(1)), Int(2)),
                  CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
                Subscript(Name("lst"), Int(1)),
                Int(0)),
              Call(
                Name("add"),
                Subscript(Name("lst"), Slice(Int(2), NoBound, NoBound))))))))
